body: Advisor notice, 18:52. The cargo target filesystem (/dev/sdd1) hit 100% (69 MB free) around 18:40-18:51; it now has 238 GB free after reaping merged and dead worktree targets. Any build or test that failed in that window with 'No space left on device', a truncated .rlib/.rmeta, or 'failed to write' should simply be re-run. If a re-run reports a corrupt incremental artifact, delete that worktree's target/<profile>/incremental dir and re-run. The permanent fix is aida-host BUG-83 (reaper plus seed disk floor), which merges shortly.
subject: Target disk was FULL ~18:40-18:51; builds in that window must be re-run
